fields.v: Criterion: component-faithfulness rubric (0-4) vs frozen checklist; IF50 primary endpoint; no success threshold stated by the authors. Agent models and versions not stated for any configuration. (1) Single-shot + Claude Code + model n.s.: MCF 3.031, DIR 0.303, IF50 0.530. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured. (2) Emergent + Claude Code + n.s.: MCF 2.718, DIR 0.149, IF50 0.414; 118/371 fully faithful, 72 severe failures. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured. (3) Single-shot + Codex + n.s.: MCF 3.245, DIR 0.289, IF50 0.550. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured. (4) Emergent + Codex + n.s.: MCF 3.242, DIR 0.148, IF50 0.479. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured. (5) Emergent + ProjectGuard + Claude Code + n.s.: MCF 3.000; 181/371 fully faithful; 49 severe failures; IF50 recovery positive on 15/20 (median +34%); DIR median +12%; memory 390 KB mean; compaction median -1. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured (overhead small). (6) Emergent + ProjectGuard + Codex + n.s.: MCF +0.05 (W/L 9/9); DIR improved on 15/19 (mean +76%, median +55%); memory 286 KB; compaction +23 mean (restarts). Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured
fields.quote: IF50 ranges from 0 to 1 and serves as our primary endpoint metric for SLUMP.
fields.why: The authors define metrics but no success threshold for a configuration, so the works/partly verdicts rest on the extractor's judgement, which the 2026-11-23 rule removes.
fields.doubt: O artigo define MCF, DIR e IF50 mas não diz a partir de que valor uma configuração 'funciona'. Os veredictos 'partly'/'works' parecem ser teus. Pela regra de 23-11, deve ficar 'no criterion stated by the authors'. Decide se a rubrica por componente conta como critério de sucesso da configuração.

fields.v: No (0): agents named (Claude Code, Codex) without versions; the models used by the agents are not stated; judge model not stated; only the benchmark-construction model snapshot is given
fields.quote: We use two commercial long-horizon coding systems, Claude Code and Codex.
fields.why: Q3 asks for agent, model and tool versions of the evaluated configurations; none is given (the only snapshot is the construction model), so Partly may be generous.
fields.doubt: Só os nomes Claude Code e Codex aparecem, sem versão nem modelo; o único modelo identificado é o que gerou o benchmark, não o agente avaliado. Vê a pág. 5 e decide se é Partly (nomes dados) ou No (nada de versões/modelos).
